symptom: `mxcli report --format html` draws every score bar as an empty grey track, whatever the score (ako/PizzaV1 shipped tools/fix_quality_html.py to patch it)
cause: The linter's own HTML formatter gave .score-fill a width but no display rule, so the inline span ignored its width; the scored report also had a style of its own, apart from every report kind
insight: Render the scored report's page through the shared Doc renderer instead of fixing the one-off CSS: one style to maintain, and the bar is a block element with a coloured fill. The renamed class (.meter) also avoids the software map's own .bar control rows, which a shared .bar rule squashed
